items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Olave (illness), Kamara (back) expected then confirmed active; Caleb returns.
items.implication: Full Saints skill involvement; Bears QB back.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/target/carry shares for Olave/Kamara; Caleb full starter.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings practice squad Tuesday).
items.why: Ankle injury; pregame workout insufficient after limited practice Friday.
items.implication: Browns RB depth thin; McLaughlin/Estime handle carries.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for McLaughlin and Estime in CLE run game.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (ankle), both questionable, are likely to play... Both officially active. With AJ Brown returning, NE is close to full health.
items.why: Sources said likely; confirmed active. AJB activated prior.
items.implication: NE offense near full strength vs Jets.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevated; no Warren targets/snaps.
items.opportunity: Increased TE targets for other Colts options or streamers.

items.implication: Bears offense at full QB strength vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Normal QB snaps/usage for Williams and CHI pass-catchers.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active.
items.why: Titans inactives confirm Spears available vs Colts.
items.implication: Spears gets RB work opposite Pollard or as change-of-pace.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share for Spears in TEN backfield.

items.text: Whoa! Popped up on injury report but still surprising. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among my fave streamer TE's ...
items.implication: Pivot to Juwan Johnson etc for TE needs.
items.opportunity: Streamer TE targets in favorable spots.

items.text: If I have to start a NYG RB I'm still starting Cam as I still think his explosiveness gives him best chance at a score. Esp against NO. But it's certainly a riskier start now. He's more of a flex than RB 2. I have Cam Skattebo at RB 28, Najee Harris at RB 33.
items.why: Rotation change after fumbles; still prefers Cam explosiveness over Najee for TD chance vs Saints.
items.implication: Start Skattebo as risky flex if needed; prefer over DK sometimes in matchups.
items.opportunity: Najee larger role opportunity but Cam still best TD upside.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Expectation is change to Giants RB rotation with Najee Harris larger role; Skattebo downgraded but still in mix. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor YOE (37th/43) and 4 fumbles prompting rotation change per sources.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex; Najee Harris upside in larger role vs NO.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Najee Harris; Skattebo still explosive but limited.

items.text: Summary of weekend FantasyFootball reports: GAME-TIME DECISION Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren, Mike Evans, Christian Kirk. EXPECTED TO PLAY Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, DK Metcalf, Pat Freiermuth, Kenyon Sadiq. NOT EXPECTED Deebo Samuel, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Sean Tucker. ACTIVATED Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Track GTD to final status; expecteds lock in projections.
items.opportunity: Role clarity for expecteds; backups for not-expected/out.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY: Deebo Samuel.
items.implication: WAS WR targets shift; sit Deebo.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for other WAS receivers like Diggs/McLaurin if healthy.

items.text: GAME-TIME DECISION: Mike Evans, Christian Kirk.
items.implication: Monitor pregame; high variance for TB WRs.

items.text: I have Cam Skattebo at RB 28, Najee Harris at RB 33 and Foster Moreau at TE 1 in my updated ranks.
items.implication: Skattebo flex territory; check full ranks at fantasylife.

items.text: My guess - and it's a pure guess - is that it'll be a split between Cam & Najee. Everyone can run in the Saints so Harris has a better shot than DK vs TB at a TD today. I'd go Najee.
items.why: Saints run-friendly; Najee TD shot better than DK vs TB.
items.implication: Prefer Najee over DK Metcalf in PPR flex choices.

items.text: Still no word on DJ Moore. No news yet on status of DJ Moore, Josh Palmer, Tyjae Spears. Projections are updated for all news.
items.implication: Uncertainty for BUF WR depth; monitor inactives.

items.text: ACTIVATED: Jaydon Blue. (Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue after placing Hurts on IR).
items.implication: PHI RB depth with Barkley etc status.
items.opportunity: Potential handcuff/backup snaps if others limited.
